answer: Correlation penalties: when many agents answer like copies of one mind, sharing phrasing, timing and a single funding source, the ledger shrinks every reward in that cluster at once. Picture a willow grove on a mesa that turns out to be one root system: cut one and all wither. An attacker spinning up fake identities must make each one genuinely distinct, which costs about as much as running real agents, so cloning yields ferrous scrap, not gold.
